annotations.title: Classify or interpret a germline variant under ACMG/AMP

description: Classify one GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel smaller than 50 bp under ACMG/AMP. Accepts genomic, coding or protein HGVS, coordinates, SPDI, rsID or a returned canonical key. Returns normalized identity, automated classification, applied criteria, ClinVar assertions, population frequencies, annotations and source provenance when available. Ambiguous input returns candidates for selection.

inputSchema.description: The only public scientific input admitted by the MCP tool.

assembly.description: Reference genome assembly. Folklore currently accepts GRCh38 only.

query.description: One germline nuclear SNV or simple indel to resolve and interpret; accepted forms include coordinates, genomic/coding/protein HGVS, SPDI, rsID, or a returned Folklore canonical_key in GRCh38:chrN:position:REF:ALT form.
